data.name: ProtocolSetsIntro
data.value: Publish protocols to linked departments as a set, or subscribe to the sets linked departments publish. Locked content follows the publisher; customizable blocks keep your changes.

data.name: CourseSetsIntro
data.value: Publish courses and trainings to linked departments as a set, or subscribe to theirs. Completions stay in each member's own record.

data.name: PublishedIntro
data.value: Linked departments you share this kind of content with can subscribe. Each new version you publish reaches their update inbox.

data.name: AvailableIntroProtocols
data.value: Sets of linked departments that share protocols with your department over a Department Link.

data.name: AvailableIntroTraining
data.value: Sets of linked departments that share training with your department over a Department Link. Courses need your own LMS add-on or the publisher's sponsorship; trainings do not.

data.name: NoAvailable
data.value: No linked department shares a set of this kind with your department yet.

data.name: NoSubscriptions
data.value: Your department has not subscribed to a set of this kind.

data.name: SuspendedHelp
data.value: The link no longer shares this content, so nothing new arrives. Your copies stay as they are.

data.name: UnsubscribeConfirm
data.value: Unsubscribe? The copies stay in your department as your own content and no more updates arrive.

data.name: SetIntro
data.value: What linked departments receive, how much they may change each item, and who subscribes.

data.name: ArchivedHelp
data.value: This set is archived: it takes no new subscribers and sends no more updates.

data.value: Days a locked update can be deferred

data.name: NoSubscribers

data.name: SubscribeConfirm
